response.overview: Esteban Pampurro—a man who abandoned his studies after years of academic mistreatment—is traveling along a rural road when he comes across a stationary car. Upon approaching, he discovers that the occupant is Felipe Salgada, his former professor, a man notorious for his hurtful temperament and his constant need to assert his own superiority.  "El Retroceso" is a tragicomedy characterized by uncomfortable humor, a minimalist aesthetic, and a profound exploration of the impact that words can have when they come from a figure of authority.
response.title: EL RETROCESO
